examGuide.title: Mental model and derivation
examGuide.body:
Sets ignore multiplicity and order. Cartesian products contain ordered pairs, whereas power sets contain subsets, including the empty set. For three sets, inclusion–exclusion subtracts pairwise intersections and restores the triple intersection. Complements are always relative to a universe. Partitioning a Venn diagram into disjoint regions prevents mixing inclusive intersection counts with counts belonging to exactly one region.

**Key relationship:** |A ∪ B| = |A| + |B| − |A ∩ B|; |P(A)| = 2^|A|

examGuide.title: A repeatable solving procedure
examGuide.body:
1. Fix the universe.
2. Identify inclusive intersections.
3. Use inclusion–exclusion and check bounds.

examGuide.title: Approach the exam question
examGuide.body: Draw overlapping regions only to establish membership, then count algebraically. Distinguish |A|, the number of subsets, and the number of elements of a power set. Inclusion–exclusion alternates signs: single-set counts overcount pairwise overlaps, while subtracting all pairs removes a triple-overlap three times and requires adding it back once.

examGuide.title: Worked problem
examGuide.body:
In a universe of 100 elements, |A|=50, |B|=45, |C|=40; pairwise intersections are 20,15,10 and the triple intersection is 5. How many elements lie in none of the sets?

**Answer: 5.** The union has 50+45+40−20−15−10+5=95 elements. Its complement has 100−95=5. Pairwise intersection counts include the triple intersection.

examGuide.title: Conditions and edge cases
examGuide.body:
State the universe before using a complement. ‘Only A’ excludes all intersections; |A| itself includes them.

The empty set is a subset of every set, but need not be an element of every set.

examGuide.title: Worked question patterns
examGuide.body:
#### Pattern 1 · MCQ

|A|=8, |B|=7, |A∩B|=3. Find |A∪B|.

- **A.** 12
- **B.** 9
- **C.** 18
- **D.** 15

**Answer: A.** Add both sizes and subtract the shared elements counted twice: 8+7−3=12.

#### Pattern 2 · MSQ

Choose valid set identities.

- **A.** A−B=A∩Bᶜ
- **B.** A∩(A∪B)=A
- **C.** A×B=B×A
- **D.** P(∅)=∅

**Answer: A, B.** Difference and absorption are valid. Cartesian products preserve pair order. P(∅) is {∅}, not ∅.

#### Pattern 3 · NAT

Three sets have sizes 20,18,15, pairwise intersections 7,6,5 and triple intersection 2. Find the union size.



**Answer: 37.** Inclusion–exclusion gives 20+18+15−7−6−5+2=37. The triple region must be restored.

examGuide.title: Work through the supplied PYQs
examGuide.body:
#### GATE 2023 CS · Q56 · NAT

[Open the original question and try it](/#/lesson/sets?tab=practice)

**What is tested:** Breadth-first and depth-first search. Refer to the original image for complete givens and diagrams.

1. The power set of {1,2,3} has 2³=8 vertices. The empty set is a proper subset of every other vertex, so it is adjacent to all seven.
2. BFS starting at ∅ discovers those seven vertices in its first adjacency scan. Every one is at distance 1; there are no further undiscovered vertices to constrain their order.
3. All 7! orders are possible, giving **5040**.
